name: plan-integrity-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `planIntegrity` flag (pro tier). FloorPlanEditor.tsx computes `planIntegrityFlags(walls, rooms, openings)` only when the flag is on, and PlanTotalLabel renders a red '⚠ N stray' badge next to the 'Total … · N rooms' readout when there are stray elements. A stray wall is added via the real `addWall` store action (an isolated 2 m segment far outside the apartment footprint, joined to nothing) so the badge has a genuine defect to report. Asserts: (1) the badge is absent in Simple mode even though the stray wall exists (flag off suppresses the whole check), (2) present once switched to Pro, (3) a direct setFeatureFlag override back to false hides it again while staying in Pro, (4) restoring the flag brings it back — isolating the flag's own effect from the mode switch.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: planIntegrity should be OFF in Simple mode (it is pro-tier)

steps.name: assert-badge-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel-sub')].map(e => e.textContent || '').find(x => x.startsWith('Total')) || ''; if (t.includes('stray') || t.includes('\u26a0')) throw new Error('Stray-element badge visible in Simple mode (planIntegrity should be off): ' + t); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: planIntegrity should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: assert-badge-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel-sub')].map(e => e.textContent || '').find(x => x.startsWith('Total')) || ''; if (!t.includes('stray')) throw new Error('Stray-element badge missing in Pro mode with a genuine stray wall present: ' + t); })()

steps.name: assert-badge-hidden-after-override
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel-sub')].map(e => e.textContent || '').find(x => x.startsWith('Total')) || ''; if (t.includes('stray')) throw new Error('Stray-element badge still visible after setFeatureFlag(planIntegrity, false) while staying in Pro: ' + t); })()

steps.name: assert-badge-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel-sub')].map(e => e.textContent || '').find(x => x.startsWith('Total')) || ''; if (!t.includes('stray')) throw new Error('Stray-element badge did not return after restoring planIntegrity to true: ' + t); })()
